verdict.rationale: Pomelo's own docs show transaction monitoring in its Dashboard, digital accounts with activity information, and reversal/refund handling through an Adjustments endpoint. That covers only a sliver of the finance-lead story. Missing for 10: documented real-time account and card balances, a ledger linking each authorization to its clearing record, settlement reporting with reconciliation, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can see money move in real time — account and card balances, a transaction ledger that ties every authorization to its clearing, and settlement reporting that reconciles to the penny

citations.quote: Monitorea toda tu operación de tarjetas, transacciones y más.
Crea cuentas digitales y obtén información sobre sus actividades.
Recibirás las transacciones de tipo Reversal y Refund a través del endpoint de Ajustes.
